decisions.rationale: Lead Incineroar+Venusaur: Fake Out flinches Talonflame/Aegislash/Overqwil, Intimidate softens physical leads, Venusaur Earth Power hits Aegislash/Garchomp 2x and Sludge Bomb hits Floette 2x. Back Weavile (4x Ice on Garchomp, priority Ice Shard on Talonflame) and Skarmory (walls Rotom-Wash via Body Press + resists Hydro Pump, immune to Overqwil Poison and Garchomp EQ, sets Tailwind). This four answers every opponent threat while keeping a bulky pivot core.
decisions.notebook: Game 1 won (series 1-0). Opponent sets: Aegislash Quiet OccaBerry StanceChange (FlashCannon/SacredSword/WideGuard/KingsShield); Overqwil Adamant PoisonBarb Intimidate (PoisonJab/ThroatChop/Taunt/Protect); Rotom-Wash Modest WideLens Levitate (HydroPump/Thunderbolt/WillOWisp/Protect); Garchomp Jolly LumBerry RoughSkin (EQ/DragonClaw/Flamethrower/Protect); Talonflame Jolly SharpBeak GaleWings (BraveBird/FlareBlitz/Tailwind/Protect); Floette-Eternal Timid Floettite FlowerVeil (Moonblast/Psychic/CalmMind/Protect) can Mega. Game 1 opener was Aegislash/Overqwil defensive with Protect/KingsShield, then aggressive Talonflame/Rotom swaps; expect possible altered opener in game 2 (fast Talonflame/Garchomp or Rotom lead). My plan: Incineroar+Venusaur lead, Weavile+Skarmory back. Venusaur Earth Power is key vs Aegislash/Garchomp, Sludge Bomb vs Floette; Skarmory Body Press walls Rotom and is immune to Overqwil Poison/Garchomp EQ; Weavile Ice Shard/IcicleCrash handles Garchomp and Talonflame; Incineroar Fake Out flinches Talonflame before Gale Wings and Parting Shot pivots. Keep Incineroar off Rotom's Water; Wide Guard blocks Gardevoir Hyper Voice if I ever bring her. Only one Mega per game: Venusaur preferred unless Floette/Thick Fat need.

decisions.rationale: Lead Talonflame and Overqwil: Gale Wings Brave Bird pressures Venusaur/Sneasler, while Intimidate and Knock Off resistance cover Weavile/Incineroar tempo. Back Rotom-Wash answers Incineroar and Skarmory, and Aegislash remains the protected Gardevoir check with Wide Guard utility. This avoids Garchomp's Ice/Fairy liabilities and keeps the key Steel/Ghost answer for Gardevoir.
decisions.notebook: Opponent's core plan: Mega Venusaur with Fake Out/Intimidate tempo, Weavile Knock Off item removal, and Gardevoir as a late cleaner; Gardevoir has unusual Levitate. Talonflame is the best Venusaur answer: immune to Earth Power, resists Giga Drain, and priority Brave Bird is more reliable than Flare Blitz into Thick Fat Mega Venusaur. Talon is frail and can be KOed by Life Orb Knock Off, so do not leave it exposed if Weavile survives. Overqwil resists Knock Off, gets Intimidate, and can Poison Jab Weavile or Taunt support; it must avoid Close Combat and strong Earth Power. Rotom-Wash checks Incineroar and Skarmory, is immune to Ground, but must avoid Venusaur Giga Drain; Hydro Pump is accurate but not guaranteed. Aegislash is the primary Gardevoir check, walls Fighting/Poison moves, and can Wide Guard Hyper Voice, but Life Orb Knock Off can OHKO it; use Protect/King's Shield and keep it healthy. Occa Berry only helps vs Fire. Skarmory Sturdy blocks one-hit KOs from full; break Sturdy or use Taunt/Will-O-Wisp. Preserve Aegislash to force Gardevoir to answer it rather than letting Weavile remove it.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out flinches Gale Wings Talonflame before its priority Brave Bird (which can OHKO Venusaur, 64-122%). Venusaur Mega-Evolves (Thick Fat vs Talonflame's Fire) and Earth Powers Overqwil for 2x, possible OHKO. If Overqwil Protects, it wastes its turn while Talonflame is flinched.
decisions.notebook: Opponent sets confirmed: Aegislash Quiet OccaBerry StanceChange (FlashCannon/SacredSword/WideGuard/KingsShield); Overqwil Adamant PoisonBarb Intimidate (PoisonJab/ThroatChop/Taunt/Protect); Rotom-Wash Modest WideLens Levitate (HydroPump/Thunderbolt/WillOWisp/Protect); Garchomp Jolly LumBerry RoughSkin (EQ/DragonClaw/Flamethrower/Protect); Talonflame Jolly SharpBeak GaleWings (BraveBird/FlareBlitz/Tailwind/Protect); Floette-Eternal Timid Floettite FlowerVeil (Moonblast/Psychic/CalmMind/Protect) can Mega. Game 2 opener was Talonflame/Overqwil (fast lead, not the defensive Aegislash/Overqwil from game 1) - opponent varies openers. My team: Incineroar/Weavile/Venusaur/Skarmory. Venusaur is my Mega (Thick Fat). Key checks: Venusaur Earth Power vs Aegislash/Garchomp/Overqwil; Sludge Bomb vs Floette; Skarmory Body Press walls Rotom, immune to Overqwil Poison/Garchomp EQ; Weavile Ice Shard/IcicleCrash vs Garchomp/Talonflame; Incineroar Fake Out beats Gale Wings priority, Parting Shot pivots. Keep Incineroar off Rotom's Water. Only one Mega per game (Venusaur preferred).

decisions.rationale: Protect Talonflame blocks the near-certain Fake Out, preserving our key Venusaur answer at full HP for Gale Wings priority next turn. Overqwil Poison Jabs Venusaur for 24-56% chip. Brave Bird at -1 can't OHKO Mega Venusaur (max 86.5%), but Poison Jab chip + Brave Bird next turn likely KOs through Thick Fat. Sludge Bomb only does 40-73% to Talonflame, so it survives one hit if targeted.
decisions.notebook: Game2 plan: Protect Talonflame T1 to dodge Fake Out, chip Venusaur with Overqwil Poison Jab, then Gale Wings Brave Bird T2 for KO. Brave Bird at -1 does 41.7-86.5% to Mega Venusaur—needs prior chip. Venusaur Sludge Bomb max 73.5% to Talonflame; Earth Power max 81.3% to Overqwil—neither OHKOs. Aegislash immune to Fake Out (Ghost), Occa Berry handles Flare Blitz, but 2x weak to Earth Power. Keep Talonflame healthy as Venusaur answer; bench it if Weavile appears (Life Orb Knock Off OHKO risk). Rotom-Wash checks Incineroar/Skarmory but fears Giga Drain. Aegislash walls Gardevoir but fears LO Knock Off. Opponent core: Mega Venusaur tempo + Fake Out/Intimidate, Weavile Knock Off, Gardevoir late cleaner with Levitate. Skarmory Sturdy needs Taunt/Wisp or multi-hit to break. Down 0-1: prioritize consistency over high-variance aggression.

decisions.rationale: Incineroar Flare Blitz guarantees KO on 12% Overqwil (min 40.6% of max > 12%). Venusaur Protects (priority +4) to block Talonflame's Gale Wings Brave Bird, which is a possible OHKO (54.5-105.9%) on our Mega. This removes Overqwil while preserving Venusaur and keeping Incineroar healthy.

Talonflame's Gale Wings Brave Bird is a possible OHKO on Venusaur-Mega (54.5-105.9% at 71% HP) - Protect or switch Venusaur when Talonflame is up. Overqwil is KO-able by Incineroar Flare Blitz even at low HP. Opponent varies openers (game1 Aegislash/Overqwil, game2 Talonflame/Overqwil).

decisions.rationale: Brave Bird gets +1 priority via Gale Wings at full HP, hitting Venusaur for 44.9-77.4%—either KOing from 71% or leaving it at ≤26%. Overqwil at 13% dies to any hit regardless; switching to Rotom-Wash converts a dead slot into a healthy pivot immune to Earth Power and resisting Flare Blitz. Next turn Talonflame cleans Venusaur while Rotom Hydro Pumps Incineroar (44.6-151.8%). Consistent line that preserves resources while down 0-1.
decisions.notebook: Gale Wings grants +1 priority Flying moves at full HP—Talonflame outspeeds everything with Brave Bird when healthy. Brave Bird at -1 vs Venusaur: 44.9-77.4%; leaves Venusaur ≤26% if no KO. Rotom-Wash Hydro Pump vs Incineroar: 44.6-151.8% (Wide Lens). Venusaur Giga Drain vs Rotom-Wash: 49.7-136%—avoid switching Rotom into predicted Giga Drain. Venusaur Sludge Bomb vs Talonflame: 58.1-83.2%. Incineroar Lariat vs Talonflame: 33.5-50.3%. Flare Blitz vs Rotom-Wash: 12.1-34.4%. Overqwil at ≤13% is effectively a pivot/sacrifice—don't invest in preserving it. Opponent back two from: Weavile (Ice Shard priority threatens Talonflame, Knock Off threatens Aegislash), Gardevoir-Mega (Pixilate Hyper Voice; Aegislash walls but fears coverage), Sneasler (Focus Sash, fast Close Combat), Skarmory (Sturdy+Tailwind; needs Taunt/Wisp/multi-hit). Series strategy down 0-1: consistency over variance. Talonflame is primary Venusaur answer—keep healthy. Rotom-Wash checks Incineroar/Skarmory but fears Giga Drain. Aegislash saves for Gardevoir/Weavile; Occa Berry handles Flare Blitz but 2x weak Earth Power. Avoid consecutive Protect on Talonflame (reduced success). If Weavile appears, bench Talonflame (LO Knock Off OHKO risk).

decisions.rationale: Venusaur is threatened by Talonflame's Gale Wings priority Brave Bird (54.5-127.7%, could KO at 71% HP), and Parting Shot resolves after it, so it can't save Venusaur. Switch Venusaur to Skarmory (switch resolves first; Sturdy survives Rotom's Thunderbolt). Incineroar Parting Shots Talonflame to drop its Attack to -2 (protecting incoming Weavile, who survives Brave Bird at -1/-2) and pivots to Weavile. This preserves Venusaur to KO Rotom later while removing the Brave Bird threat to our Mega.

Key checks: Venusaur Earth Power vs Aegislash/Garchomp/Overqwil; Sludge Bomb vs Floette; Skarmory (Sturdy) walls physical, immune to Overqwil Poison/Garchomp EQ, but weak to Rotom Thunderbolt (Sturdy saves once) and Talonflame Flare Blitz; Weavile Ice moves are NEUTRAL on Talonflame (Fire resists Ice) - Icicle Crash 31-113%, Knock Off 24-87%; Weavile outspeeds Talonflame/Rotom. Incineroar Fake Out beats Gale Wings priority but only on its first turn out. Talonflame's Gale Wings Brave Bird is a priority OHKO threat on Venusaur-Mega - switch or Protect Venusaur when Talonflame is up; Parting Shot resolves after Brave Bird so cannot save it same turn. Rotom Hydro Pump 2x on Incineroar (66-120%, Sitrus helps). Only one Mega per game (Venusaur preferred). Opponent varies openers (game1 Aegislash/Overqwil, game2 Talonflame/Overqwil).

decisions.rationale: Switch Incineroar to Weavile. Weavile survives Talonflame's priority Brave Bird (max ~64%) and can KO the 12% Overqwil with Icicle Crash (neutral, ~90-106%). Venusaur-Mega at 71% is at real risk of being KO'd by Brave Bird if Talonflame is max-Atk (~79-93%), so keep it safe. Skarmory passes: it walls physical attackers (Sturdy, resists Brave Bird, immune to Poison Jab).
decisions.notebook: Opponent sets confirmed: Aegislash Quiet OccaBerry StanceChange (FlashCannon/SacredSword/WideGuard/KingsShield); Overqwil Adamant PoisonBarb Intimidate (PoisonJab/ThroatChop/Taunt/Protect); Rotom-Wash Modest WideLens Levitate (HydroPump/Thunderbolt/WillOWisp/Protect); Garchomp Jolly LumBerry RoughSkin (EQ/DragonClaw/Flamethrower/Protect); Talonflame Jolly SharpBeak GaleWings (BraveBird/FlareBlitz/Tailwind/Protect); Floette-Eternal Timid Floettite FlowerVeil (Moonblast/Psychic/CalmMind/Protect) can Mega. Damage facts: Weavile survives Talonflame Brave Bird at -2 Atk (max ~64%); Venusaur-Mega at ~71% can be KO'd by max-Atk Talonflame Brave Bird (~79-93%) so keep it off the field vs Talonflame; Weavile Icicle Crash KOs 12% Overqwil (neutral) and threatens Talonflame (31-113%); Weavile Knock Off is resisted on Overqwil (Dark) so use Icicle Crash; Overqwil Poison Jab can OHKO Weavile if max-Atk, so don't leave Weavile exposed to it; Talonflame Flare Blitz super-effective on Skarmory but Sturdy saves once; Thick Fat halves Flare Blitz on Venusaur. Weavile outspeeds Talonflame/Rotom; handles Garchomp (4x Ice) and Aegislash (Knock Off 2x); Venusaur handles Floette (Sludge Bomb) and Aegislash (Earth Power). Only one Mega per game (Venusaur).

decisions.rationale: Brave Bird is the strongest immediate pressure on Venusaur and goes first via Gale Wings. Rotom is too fragile to Venusaur's Giga Drain, so pivot Overqwil in: Intimidate softens Incineroar, Overqwil can absorb the likely Giga Drain/Earth Power, and Rotom stays available. Overqwil is expendable; preserving Rotom and Aegislash for the back line matters more.
decisions.notebook: Durable: Talonflame Brave Bird at -1 vs Venusaur-Mega 44.9-77.4%; at -2 33.2-59.4%, guaranteed only if Venusaur is very low. Brave Bird recoil removes full-HP Gale Wings priority after attacking. Rotom-Wash Hydro Pump vs Incineroar 75.2-135.3% with Wide Lens, possible KO but 88% accurate; Thunderbolt Incineroar only 30.2-55.3%. Venusaur Giga Drain 73.8-107.8% vs Rotom-Wash, so Protect or pivot Rotom rather than leaving it exposed. Overqwil is a disposable Intimidate pivot: it can absorb Venusaur Giga Drain/Earth Power and weaken Incineroar, but Venusaur may recover slightly by KOing it. Preserve Aegislash for Gardevoir/Weavile; Venusaur Earth Power chips Aegislash 33.5-72.6, Incineroar Lariat 29.9-66.7, Flare Blitz 20.4-46.7 with Occa Berry. Knock Off threatens Aegislash. If Skarmory appears, prioritize Taunt/Wisp/Electric damage; Rotom Thunderbolt is the best immediate hit. Against Weavile, avoid exposing weakened Talonflame; Aegislash can take Ice Shard but fears Knock Off. Sneasler's Focus Sash requires priority or multi-hit; Talonflame Brave Bird is super effective but Sash can survive. Gardevoir is walled by Aegislash. Prefer consistency over variance.

decisions.rationale: Weavile outspeeds Overqwil and Icicle Crash (26-60% of max) cleanly KOs its 12% HP, removing the Poison Jab OHKO threat before it acts. Skarmory sets Tailwind to give speed advantage for the rest of the game while Talonflame sits at -2 Atk and is less urgent. This is safe: even if Talonflame priority Brave Birds Weavile, Weavile survives (~64% max) and still KOs Overqwil.
decisions.notebook: Opponent sets confirmed: Aegislash Quiet OccaBerry StanceChange (FlashCannon/SacredSword/WideGuard/KingsShield); Overqwil Adamant PoisonBarb Intimidate (PoisonJab/ThroatChop/Taunt/Protect); Rotom-Wash Modest WideLens Levitate (HydroPump/Thunderbolt/WillOWisp/Protect); Garchomp Jolly LumBerry RoughSkin (EQ/DragonClaw/Flamethrower/Protect); Talonflame Jolly SharpBeak GaleWings (BraveBird/FlareBlitz/Tailwind/Protect); Floette-Eternal Timid Floettite FlowerVeil (Moonblast/Psychic/CalmMind/Protect) can Mega. My team Incineroar/Weavile/Venusaur/Skarmory; Venusaur is my Mega (Thick Fat). Weavile (194) outspeeds Overqwil/Rotom/Garchomp/Floette; ties/edges Talonflame (160-195). Weavile Icicle Crash KOs low-HP Overqwil; Knock Off resisted on Overqwil so use Icicle Crash. Weavile survives Talonflame Brave Bird at -2 Atk (~64% max). Venusaur-Mega must stay off field vs Talonflame (Brave Bird ~79-93% KO). Skarmory Sturdy saves once vs Flare Blitz; Thick Fat halves Flare Blitz on Venusaur. Weavile handles Garchomp (4x Ice) and Aegislash (Knock Off 2x); Venusaur handles Floette (Sludge Bomb) and Aegislash (Earth Power). Only one Mega per game (Venusaur).

decisions.rationale: Protect Talonflame to scout and preserve its 95% HP—Flare Blitz at -2 only does 40-96% to Weavile (no KO) while risking Icicle Crash (62-90%) plus recoil. Switch Overqwil (13%, disposable) to Rotom-Wash: it survives Knock Off (25-69%), resists Icicle Crash (16-44%), and tanks Body Press (19-53%), while Aegislash risks a Knock Off OHKO (38-103%). Next turn Rotom threatens Skarmory with Thunderbolt (60-184%) and Talonflame can Tailwind or attack.
decisions.notebook: Game2: Ice is NEUTRAL on Talonflame (Fire resists Ice 0.5x × Flying weak 2x = 1x), not 4x. Ice Shard 30-43%, Icicle Crash 62-90% to Talonflame. Talonflame Flare Blitz at -2 Atk vs Weavile only 40.7-96.6%, no OHKO. Weavile Knock Off vs Aegislash 38.9-103.7% possible OHKO—never switch Aegislash into predicted Knock Off. Rotom-Wash is safe vs Weavile/Skarmory: Knock Off 25-69%, Icicle Crash 16-44% (resisted), Body Press 19-53%; Thunderbolt vs Skarmory 60.5-184.3% possible OHKO (2x SE). Rotom Thunderbolt vs Incineroar only 30-55%; Hydro Pump vs Incineroar 75-135% but 88% accurate. Venusaur Giga Drain 73-107% vs Rotom—Protect or pivot. Aegislash Sacred Sword is 4x SE on Weavile (Fighting vs Dark/Ice) but Aegislash very slow (Quiet). Skarmory Sturdy only at full HP. Opponent lacks Gardevoir/Sneasler this game. Prioritize Tailwind when Talonflame safe; Rotom Will-O-Wisp to neuter Weavile/Incineroar physical attacks.

decisions.rationale: Double-up on Talonflame to remove the priority threat. Gale Wings is inactive (Talonflame at 95%, not full HP), so its Brave Bird has no priority; Weavile (388) and Skarmory (180) both outspeed it. Weavile Icicle Crash (36-70%) + Skarmory Brave Bird (30-59%) gives a strong KO chance on the 95% bird, and Weavile survives any -2 Atk hit. Rotom at 42% is handled next turn.
decisions.notebook: Opponent sets confirmed: Aegislash Quiet OccaBerry StanceChange (FlashCannon/SacredSword/WideGuard/KingsShield); Overqwil Adamant PoisonBarb Intimidate (PoisonJab/ThroatChop/Taunt/Protect); Rotom-Wash Modest WideLens Levitate (HydroPump/Thunderbolt/WillOWisp/Protect); Garchomp Jolly LumBerry RoughSkin (EQ/DragonClaw/Flamethrower/Protect); Talonflame Jolly SharpBeak GaleWings (BraveBird/FlareBlitz/Tailwind/Protect); Floette-Eternal Timid Floettite FlowerVeil (Moonblast/Psychic/CalmMind/Protect) can Mega. Opponent's 4th this game is one of Aegislash/Garchomp/Floette (unrevealed). My team Incineroar/Weavile/Venusaur/Skarmory; Venusaur is my Mega (Thick Fat). Weavile (194) outspeeds Overqwil/Rotom/Garchomp/Floette; ties/edges Talonflame. Gale Wings only active at full HP - keep Talonflame below full to deny priority. Weavile survives Talonflame Brave Bird at -2 Atk (~29-43%) and Flare Blitz (~57-86%). Venusaur-Mega must stay off field vs a full-HP Talonflame (Brave Bird ~79-93% KO); safe once Talonflame is damaged. Skarmory Sturdy saves once vs Flare Blitz; Thick Fat halves Flare Blitz on Venusaur. Weavile handles Garchomp (4x Ice) and Aegislash (Knock Off 2x); Venusaur handles Floette (Sludge Bomb) and Aegislash (Earth Power). Only one Mega per game (Venusaur).

decisions.rationale: Tailwind is critical: with both winds active, Talonflame (390) outspeeds Weavile (318-388) and Rotom (248) outspeeds Skarmory (180-244). Will-O-Wisp on Weavile halves its physical attacks. Opponent must choose: target Talonflame (Rotom gets free Wisp) or target Rotom (Talonflame gets free Tailwind). Either way we gain value. Icicle Crash on Rotom only 17.7-39%, Rotom survives to Wisp.
decisions.notebook: Game2: With both Tailwinds active, Talonflame eff Speed 390 outspeeds Weavile 318-388; Rotom 248 outspeeds Skarmory 180-244. Weavile Knock Off vs Rotom-Wash 34-61% (KO risk at low HP); Icicle Crash vs Rotom only 17.7-39%. Icicle Crash vs Talonflame 56-98.7% (KO risk at 95% HP). Aegislash walls Skarmory completely: immune to Body Press (Ghost), resists Brave Bird 0.5x. Aegislash Sacred Sword 4x SE on Weavile 38-165% but Aegislash Speed 72 means Weavile always moves first. Weavile Knock Off vs Aegislash 37-112% possible OHKO—never switch Aegislash into predicted Knock Off. Skarmory Sturdy blocks OHKO at full HP; Thunderbolt 76.7-184.3% breaks Sturdy leaving 1 HP. Burn Weavile to halve all physical damage. Opponent Tailwind expires 1 turn before mine if both set turn 5. Plan: burn Weavile, get Tailwind, then Aegislash cleans with Sacred Sword. Overqwil at 13% is expendable pivot only.

decisions.rationale: Double-up Icicle Crash + Brave Bird on Talonflame to secure the KO of the biggest threat. Weavile (388) outspeeds Talonflame except at its top speed roll; if Weavile's hit doesn't finish it, Skarmory's Brave Bird (30-59%) cleans up. Accept that Skarmory may fall to Rotom Thunderbolt (88-133%); I still hold Incineroar + Venusaur-Mega vs Rotom + the unrevealed 4th, a favorable 3v2.

decisions.rationale: Weavile is burned at 69% and Aegislash's Flash Cannon (~99-118%) KOs it, so Weavile must act first and we need a switch-in that safely answers Aegislash. Venusaur-Mega resists Aegislash's Flash Cannon (8.6-31.6%) and Sacred Sword (2.7-11.6%), tanks easily, and pressures it with Earth Power (2x). Incineroar is weak to Rotom's Hydro Pump (2x) and Aegislash's Sacred Sword (2x), and its Intimidate won't save Weavile from special Flash Cannon. Venusaur-Mega also handles Floette if it's the benched 4th, while Weavile covers Garchomp. Bring Venusaur-Mega.

Plan: Weavile acts first to pressure/remove a threat; Venusaur-Mega tanks Aegislash and whittles it; keep Talonflame below full to deny Gale Wings.

decisions.rationale: Talonflame at -2 Atk/39% is dead weight; switching to Aegislash walls Skarmory (immune Body Press, resists Brave Bird) and burned Weavile Knock Off maxes at 51.9%. reflections.summary: The game and series were won because Venusaur-Mega was the central offensive answer, landing super effective Earth Power on Overqwil and Aegislash and Giga Drain on Rotom-Wash, while Incineroar's Intimidate and Fake Out disrupted the opponent's physical attackers. Weavile applied pressure with Knock Off and Icicle Crash, and Skarmory's Tailwind gave speed control. The opponent's Rotom Protect failed at a critical moment, allowing Venusaur to finish it. The series was closed 2-0 with consistent pressure and correct Mega choice.
reflections.adjustment: Against this opponent, I would keep Venusaur-Mega as the core but consider replacing Skarmory with a bulkier support or a faster Tailwind user, since Skarmory was KO'd early by Rotom's Thunderbolt. I would also give Weavile a Lum Berry or Safety Goggles to mitigate burn or priority, though its burn did not cost the game. The overall plan of using Venusaur to target their Ground-weak Pokémon and Incineroar for Intimidate cycling worked well.
reflections.notebook: Opponent tendencies: Overqwil has Intimidate and is physically frail; Aegislash is weak to Ground/Dark and carries Occa Berry; Rotom-Wash is bulky and uses Protect frequently (may fail under pressure); Talonflame has Gale Wings priority and is frail; Garchomp and Floette-Eternal were not brought but remain threats. Venusaur-Mega with Earth Power and Giga Drain is a reliable answer to Overqwil, Aegislash, and Rotom. Incineroar's Intimidate is key to neutering their physical attackers. Weavile can check Garchomp if brought. Rotom's Protect can be baited and may fail. Keep Venusaur healthy to handle late-game Rotom.

reflections.summary: Lost game 2 and the series because the four brought did not solve Mega Venusaur. The between-game lead adjustment helped with Intimidate and burn, but the larger plan failed: we brought no Mega, evolved none, and let their Venusaur become the final threat. Aegislash was the wrong fourth into Knock Off and Earth Power, consecutive Protect reliance failed, and Overqwil chip was insufficient. Prep got the early Intimidate and burn script right, but the registered six and sets were misaligned: Aegislash and Overqwil were too fragile for this core, Rotom-Wash relied on high-variance Hydro Pump, and leaving Mega Floette out while facing a Mega was a poor matchup call. Manectric or Serperior from the bench deserved evaluation.
reflections.adjustment: In a future series, build around a dedicated Venusaur answer instead of relying on Poison Jab chip. If Mega Floette is available, bring and evolve it or otherwise answer their Mega; do not let Venusaur recover and close the game. Use Overqwil only as a short Intimidate pivot and consider Taunt to stop Protect or recovery, but never leave it exposed to Earth Power. Keep Rotom-Wash for Will-O-Wisp and Hydro Pump, but avoid stacking Protect and provide backup for Hydro Pump variance. Do not switch Aegislash into predicted double-target pressure; if brought, it needs a protected late-game role. Consider Manectric or Serperior over Aegislash or Overqwil if their typing and moves better answer this core.
reflections.notebook: Opponent likely leads Incineroar and Venusaur, evolves Venusaur early, and uses Fake Out, Parting Shot, Intimidate, and Sitrus recovery to enable. Skarmory provides Tailwind and Roost recovery. Weavile is Life Orb, Pressure, and dangerous with Ice and Knock, but burn sharply reduces its threat. Venusaur uses Earth Power, Sludge Bomb, Giga Drain, and Protect, and can recover late. They double-target switch-ins and punish predictable Protect. Overqwil Intimidate is useful but frail to Earth Power. Rotom-Wash can burn Weavile and threaten Incineroar, but Wide Lens Hydro Pump is risky. Aegislash is vulnerable to Earth Power and Knock Off. Talonflame can pressure Venusaur and Skarmory but must not be wasted. Prep conclusions: burn Weavile early, limit consecutive Protect, bring a stronger Venusaur answer, and avoid passive chip-only plans.
